scripts.clean: rm -f jelly.js dist/jelly.js src/generated/inline-assets.js && rm -rf release
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p release .npm-cache && npm pack --cache .npm-cache --pack-destination release
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run package
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run package
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && npm run package
scripts.dev: echo "Edit src/, then run: npm run build && npm run deploy"
